I set up the recurring "Pod end of day" post for #strategic-pod, weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time (22:30 UTC). It won't fire yet: the Hermes gateway isn't running on this host, so the job is saved but inactive. Someone needs to start the gateway (`hermes gateway start`) before the first run.

Two other things to know:
- The job's next run is set from the real clock (Monday Oct 26, 22:30 UTC), so today's Oct 14 run won't happen.
- I haven't tested that the scheduled job can read the channel and post as the bot. The first real run will show whether it works.

I replied in the #strategic-pod thread with the same caveats.
